_comment: Skeleton village type. Place under cultures/<culture>/village_type/<name>.json. Exactly one layout entry with role=centre is required.
name: My Village
_weight_comment: 0 = no natural spawn (use /millenaire spawn to test). Set to 10+ once ready for natural spawn.
_biome_tags_comment: Either biome tags (start with #) or exact biome ResourceLocations. See the vanilla biome registry for valid values.
_layout_roles_comment: Valid roles: centre, start, secondary, optional. Exactly one entry must be role=centre (the townhall).
